name: Charon homeworld
description: The homeworld of the Charon species was located in otherspace. It was located near a massive black hole.
lead_paragraphs: The homeworld of the Charon species was located in otherspace. It was located near a massive black hole.
The planet was the first to fall victim to the Charon Death Cult, who cleansed the world of all non-believers before turning their attention to the rest of otherspace.
